title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S06 E09 — California Flood Fiasco
A perfect storm with tragic consequences strikes as floodwaters rip away a major highway crossing in Huron, Calif.; experts use the latest tech to investigate and reveal bridge scouring with unsupported concrete columns exposed for failure.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S06 E07 — Blaze of Winston-Salem
A catastrophic fire at a fertilizer plant threatens city-wide devastation in Winston-Salem, N.C.; experts use the latest science to investigate an outdated, wooden storage facility heavily stocked with volatile, explosive chemicals.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S07 E02 — Island Observatory Failure
In Puerto Rico, an iconic observatory nestled into a giant crater has to close after cables holding up a critical platform come crashing down; experts analyze the cumulative effects that led to the collapse of this awe-inspiring structure.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S06 E03 — Jacksonville's Parking Garage Disaster
The construction of a new parking garage at a luxury waterside condo turns disastrous as it collapses in Jacksonville, Fla.; experts use the latest tech to investigate and uncover critical design flaws and unsupported lower levels.

title: Outlaw Tech
description:
S01 E06 — World's Smartest Thief
A thief uses his cunning and a few high-tech gadgets to steal a priceless treasure from a heavily guarded palace; bank robbers tunnel underground to hit an impregnable vault; hackers try to steal $440 million from a bank using its own defenses.

title: Outlaw Tech
description:
S01 E03 — The Real Ocean's 11
A criminal mastermind breaches a bank vault and steals over $100 million in jewels; a simple invention helps thieves make off with over $5 million in gold; when over 500 luxury cars vanish, authorities uncover a high-tech hack worth $30 mil.

title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S04 E04 — The Earth Next Door
Astronomers notice a planet in Earth's vicinity capable of supporting life; top secret military program exposed; the moon contains the components to start life.

title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S06 E01 — Saturn's Moon Monsters
When NASA discovers something strange on Saturn's biggest moon, experts investigate if aliens feeding on the world's electric atmosphere could be the culprit; the disturbing evidence points to an apocalypse if these monsters ever make it to Earth.

title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S04 E07 — Mystery of the Invisible Planet
A probe malfunctions without cause as it enters deep space; a mission goes astray when an imposter breaches Mission Control; evidence of an invisible planet within the Solar System.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S06 E02 — Twin Suns: The Alien Mysteries
Star systems with binary stars, once relegated to science-fiction, may actually exist and serve as ideal places for alien life to thrive.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S06 E06 — Secret History of Mercury
Mercury is a deadly world, facing attacks from the Sun, comets, and other planets; even though it's the smallest planet in the solar system, Mercury has a dangerous secret that may one day threaten life on Earth.

title: Black Files Declassified
description:
S02 E03 — Secret World of Mind Control
Many U.S. government personnel have reported sustaining unexplained and debilitating neurological injuries while working abroad; Mike Baker investigates if these invisible, mind-altering attacks are evidence of active mind-control programs worldwide.

title: Black Files Declassified
description:
S02 E05 — Presidential Power Secrets
Presidential Emergency Action Documents have the potential to grant the U.S. president unlimited authority; Mike Baker investigates how these files are among the most secretive documents in U.S. government and what might trigger their use.

title: Black Files Declassified
description:
S02 E08 — Riddle of the Red Cell
In the aftermath of the 9/11 attacks, a series of secret meetings were reported between US military brass and Hollywood filmmakers.

title: Black Files Declassified
description:
S02 E01 — Future Robotic Warfare
Former CIA operative Mike Baker investigates top-secret government programs steeped in cutting-edge science; Mike speaks with experts, government officials and scientists to go deeper into the black files than ever before.

title: Black Files Declassified
description:
S02 E02 — Secrets of the Paranormal
Uncovered documents reveal a black file containing studies of werewolves, sprites and floating orbs; Mike Baker investigates how the U.S. government may have funded a classified program directly focused on the research of paranormal phenomena.

title: Black Files Declassified
description:
S02 E07 — Mystery of Mission 7
In 2013, the USS Jimmy Carter deployed on a classified mission that received a presidential citation of heroism.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S10 E02 — Castle Kingdom
Half-built castles stand as a whimsical reminder of a neighborhood that was supposed to feature thermal baths and panoramic views; the ambitious project came to an abrupt halt when the construction company began to face financial difficulties.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S10 E03 — Rock 'N' Roll Island
This Caribbean mecca for rock legends was envisioned by famous Beatles' producer George Martin; although many legendary records were made there, the studio had to close after a series of natural disasters rocked the small island.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S10 E08 — Turkish Wonderland
In the Turkish capital, ambitious plans for a new amusement park are disrupted by financial, mechanical and political problems, forcing the park to close; now its old roller coasters stand as symbols of excess on the city skyline.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S10 E04 — K-Pop Dreamland
This Seoul amusement park is full of rusted-out rides and unfinished renovations; forced to close due to financial problems, the park has found a second life after being used as the setting of K-pop album covers and music videos.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S10 E06 — Blues Prison
Formerly known as one of the toughest prisons in America, this massive complex was once home to medical experiments and a chaotic hostage situation; it's better remembered as the setting for the iconic opening scene of "The Blues Brothers."

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S10 E12 — The Ruins of Archaeopolis
This decaying fortress once stood between the Ancient Roman and Persian Empires; though the stronghold's location attracted great wealth, it also attracted attention from unfriendly neighbors.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S10 E10 — The Ruins of Troy
In modern-day Turkey, on the coast of the Aegean Sea, archaeologists discovered hilltop ruins that are believed to be the site of one of the world's most enduring stories -- the legend of Troy and the Trojan Horse.

title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S06 E07 — Planet of the Metal Aliens
Experts investigate if a nearby exoplanet could be the home to an alien civilization of strange, metallic monsters, after a new discovery confirms that life can thrive on such a strange world.

title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S05 E01 — JFK UFO Conspiracy
A declassified letter written by President Kennedy demands that the CIA share its UFO data with NASA; a bizarre pattern on the surface of Mars could be a coded alien message; investigators find a rocket crash-landed in a crater on the Moon.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S06 E04 — Death of the Milky Way
Experts utilize the latest science and discoveries to investigate the cause of the Milky Way galaxy's gradual death.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S06 E05 — Uranus & Neptune: Rise of the Ice Giants
Uranus and Neptune are mysterious, icy worlds at the edge of the solar system; new discoveries reveal that these strange planets may have helped start life on Earth.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S07 E01 — Terror of Nazi Propaganda
After seizing power in 1933, Adolf Hitler began systematically transforming a peaceful German population into a ruthless war machine; experts investigate the innovative methods used by the Nazis to indoctrinate and control the will of its citizens.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S07 E02 — The Devil's Bible
"The Codex Gigas," also known as the "Devil's Bible," is a giant medieval tome that has evoked fear for centuries and is believed to contain a malevolent power; experts investigate its legendary secrets and uncover the mystery behind its author.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S07 E03 — Mary Magdalene Enigma
Mary Magdalene played a pivotal role in early Christianity and witnessed the execution and resurrection of Jesus Christ; experts investigate the truth behind her mysterious disappearance and embark on a quest to locate her undiscovered remains.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S07 E04 — Secrets of Gobekli Tepe
The ancient site of Göbekli Tepe is the oldest building complex ever discovered and continues to baffle archaeologists; experts investigate new theories behind its construction as a possible commemoration to a cataclysmic event.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S07 E05 — Mystery of the Hypogeum
A subterranean Neolithic temple discovered on the island of Malta contains the skeletal remains of thousands of humans; experts use forensic archaeology to investigate elongated skulls that may unlock the secrets of an advanced, lost civilization.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S07 E06 — Secrets of the Crucifixion
Uncover the true stories surrounding great treasures, long-held conspiracy theories, ancient relics and lost civilizations as experts analyze and investigate history's most astonishing mysteries.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S07 E07 — MK-Ultra Revealed
The CIA's MK-Ultra program sought to create mind control methods through unethical human experimentation, and now, experts investigate classified documents that reveal the horrific atrocities that were carried out in the pursuit of national security.

title: What on Earth?
description:
S04 E07 — The Minotaur's Lair
A strange lake in Transylvania is the home of an abandoned village and a terrifying secret; when a labyrinth is discovered on an island once home to an ancient Greek civilization, experts investigate if it was the legendary home of the Minotaur.

title: What on Earth?
description:
S04 E06 — Village of the Damned
A forbidden island points to a strange South American town that locals claim was the home of Adolf Hitler; new data from NASA satellites might reveal a sunken lost continent in the Indian Ocean; a pit of bodies suggests fears of a zombie nightmare.

title: What on Earth?
description:
S04 E09 — Finding King Arthur
An abandoned megacity in a remote jungle might be the home of an ancient treasure and a dark secret; when a mysterious circular stone structure is discovered in Scotland, experts investigate whether it's the fabled Round Table of King Arthur.

title: What on Earth?
description:
S04 E08 — The Lost City of Goliath
A lost city near Jerusalem might have been the home of Goliath; bizarre underwater formations might point to a top-secret US weapons testing facility; a strange sighting in the Arctic could be a lost Nazi relic.

title: What on Earth?

S04 E10 — Treasures of Valhalla
Evidence of human sacrifice for the Viking god Odin; shedding new light on Genghis Khan.

The team tests if NASA really did land on the Moon.

title: Truth Behind the Moon Landing
description:
S01 E02 — Fire in the Cockpit
Some believe the fire on Apollo One that killed three astronauts was a top-secret cover-up, and a team of experts investigates if this disaster was a tragic accident or part of a conspiracy to fake the moon landing.

title: Truth Behind the Moon Landing
description:
S01 E01 — NASA Nazi Conspiracy
A team of experts investigates if there was a conspiracy to fake the moon landing, and uncovers a secret report on hundreds of Nazis involved in the Apollo space program.

title: Truth Behind the Moon Landing
description:
S01 E05 — CIA's Secret Space War
Confidential CIA files reveal a top-secret war for space between the US and the Soviets, and a team of experts investigates if new discoveries about American espionage during the Apollo program provide evidence of a conspiracy.

title: Truth Behind the Moon Landing
description:
S01 E03 — Killing Armstrong
Apollo 11's lunar module nearly killed Neil Armstrong during training, and some believe this close-call could explain a conspiracy to fake the moon landing; investigating if dangers that the Apollo 11 crew faced were motive for a cover-up.

title: Truth Behind the Moon Landing
description:
S01 E04 — Conspiracy of the Lost Tapes
The NASA tapes that recorded the Apollo 11 moon landing are missing, and some believe their disappearance is part of a cover-up to hide the truth; experts use cutting-edge tech to hunt for this lost evidence and shed light on a possible conspiracy.

title: Truth Behind the Moon Landing
description:
S01 E06 — The Hollywood Conspiracy
Some believe that the moon's waving American flag is the smoking gun that NASA faked the moon landing, and as a team of experts investigates this strange piece of evidence, the trail leads all the way to some of Hollywood's biggest names.

title: Conspiracies Decoded
description:
S01 E06 — Finding Amelia Earhart
Aviator Amelia Earhart's disappearance is one of the greatest unsolved mysteries, but forensic science might finally crack the case, as experts examine human remains that could be proof positive of her whereabouts.

title: Conspiracies Decoded
description:
S01 E05 — Secrets of the Scorpion
A nuclear submarine goes missing while spying on Soviet maneuvers, and its wreckage is found on the ocean floor.

title: Conspiracies Decoded
description:
S01 E09 — Hitler's Escape Enigma
Adolph Hitler disappears from the world in an apparent suicide at the end of World War II, but theories of his possible escape continue to circulate; experts use forensic science to examine remains that could finally solve the mystery of his fate.

title: Conspiracies Decoded
description:
S01 E03 — Nazi Doomsday Project
Brand-new evidence reveals the secrets of a Nazi program to build a nuclear bomb; using cutting-edge science and technology, experts uncover classified files that reveal how close Hitler came to this terrifying super weapon.

title: Conspiracies Decoded
description:
S01 E04 — Yellowstone Supervolcano
Beneath Yellowstone National Park is one of the world's largest active volcanoes, and it's poised to erupt at any moment; experts use seismic technology and visual imaging to reveal its catastrophic threat.

title: Conspiracies Decoded
description:
S01 E02 — Mystery at Alcatraz
Three inmates are said to have escaped from Alcatraz prison, but even today, it's never been proven; new evidence might finally crack this notorious cold case, as experts use forensic science and cutting-edge technology to investigate fresh leads.
